findings.finding: Per-model-size hardware tables (peft memory table, vllm sizing table) cannot be encoded as a scalar unit-level requires.hardware.vram_gb without mis-gating — the number is conditional on model size.
findings.resolution: Hardware tables live in reference units; requires carries only unconditional gates (min_gpu_count, runtime, stage).
findings.implication: Linker design: the deterministic hard filter fires on runtime/min_gpu_count/stage; vram_gb hard-gates only when a unit has an unconditional VRAM floor. Model-size-conditional VRAM reasoning is the temp-0 selector's job, fed by reference units.

findings.finding: Conditional runtime requirements (HF_TOKEN only for gated models; network only for cloud storage; multi-gpu only above a scale) are inexpressible in the flat requires vocabulary.
findings.resolution: requires holds only unconditional needs; conditions stay in procedure steps. No new field needed.
findings.implication: Hard filter stays conservative (three-valued logic: unknown never rejects).

findings.finding: synthesized_fields is field-granular: one synthesized item among three supported validation items marks the whole field.
findings.resolution: Conservative over-flagging accepted for the MVP (E1 audits flagged fields at the stricter bar).
findings.implication: Post-MVP candidate: per-item derivation annotation. Not needed to test H1-H4.

findings.finding: Artifact naming drifts without a convention (ml:dataset vs ml:training-dataset used variably across manifests).
findings.resolution: E1 compiler prompt should carry a canonical starter list of ml:* names; library-specific namespaces stay open.
findings.implication: Not a schema change; matters once artifact hints participate in linking.

findings.finding: Corpus quality evidence: verl SKILL.md links references/multi-turn.md which does not exist in the bundle (dead link shipped in the corpus); ray-data ships zero failure/recovery content.
findings.resolution: Dead-reference validation (already in the validator) is demonstrably necessary; recovery-absence surfaces as warnings, not fabrication.
findings.implication: E1's grounding critic must treat the skill package itself as fallible input.

findings.finding: The canonical stage 'explore' (MLEvolve: evolution) attracted no unit in any manifest — no doc content is evolution-specific.
findings.resolution: Stage hints omitted default to all stages at link time; explore nodes will draw from generate/refine-tagged units.
findings.implication: Watch in E2 whether explore-stage selections differ from refine; if never, delivery.stages may simplify.
